## Mod submission

- **Repo:** https://github.com/
- **What it does:**

### Checklist

- [ ] My entry is at the end of `community-mods.json`, and the PR changes nothing else.
- [ ] `id` matches `name` in my `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
- [ ] I've published a GitHub release (not a draft or pre-release).
- [ ] My repo has a README that says what the mod does and discloses any network access.
- [ ] My repo has a LICENSE.
- [ ] `claude plugin validate` passes, and I've tried the mod in a real session.
- [ ] I've read the review rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
